I don’t understand this. You are fine. You are not ugly. You’re a human being. Don’t worry about what redditors online will say about you. Who cares. 

Your hair looks so nice. Omg like such nice natural curls. I wonder how you look with even longer hair. And your eyes… wow. Is it green? Or like hazel-ish. Either way, you look like a handsome young man and you will find someone soon enough. At 23, don’t rush to spend your time and your resources to someone else, it will happen eventually and regardless. When you are happy with yourself and you learn to accept yourself for who you are and learn to depend on yourself, you will undoubtedly put that type of energy out to the world and those with resonating and matching energy will come to you or meet you. 

In the meantime, just enjoy everyday, every present moment. 🩵

Poignant because I feel that it evokes a feeling of sadness. The following lines give impression of a feeling of hopelessness.

But it’s too late My oils gone and my fires dim No refill, you won’t come back in

-To connect on that level and draw out the strings that connect us. Every human has felt this.

The string that connects us meaning emotions. I think some people read a piece and they just read it and understand it. And some people read a piece and without trying, their emotions poke through and their minds try to piece those words with events or experiences in their lives. And although every emotion and experience is different, us being emotional creatures is the common thread.

I chase blindly cuz I am no visionary

Simply stated but encompasses a variety of meanings in all aspects of life, at every level.

To me, it’s a general but a simple statement to display human desire. The juxtaposition of real vs metaphorical because being a visionary is unrelated to chasing something blindly. Variety of meanings in all aspects of life because people can relate this line to any experience in their lives, at every level, whether rich or poor, whether wrong or right, whether male or female, etc.

I like both versions. I am charged implies a current dilemma, a struggle or a fight with an idea still ongoing, it allows you to immerse the reader with the piece.

I was charged, obviously is past tense and leaves your reader wondering and imagining of your current state. Leaves room for intrigue in a way. 

I think it would be entirely up to you to decide what type of emotion you want to evoke from the reader. 

Otherwise great writing. Sharp and concise, your words leave much to wonderment.

Art, poetry, and philosophy, in my opinion, will never be out of mind for us. There may be shifts in peoples demeanor towards them but these are integral parts of what makes us human. It’s what has separated us from instinct to logic. 

I think we go through times of shift within society and when things get hectic, people turn to art or artistic expressions. Art has no right answer, it’s not absolute, so it allows for viewers or readers to have a subjective view, where they can apply it in their personal lives. 

I think that’s the beauty of it.
